subject.title: fix(subagent): recover terminal transcript before lost context

question: Should maintainers accept the current-run private transcript successful-terminal-turn predicate as the lifecycle recovery boundary after rebasing this dirty draft branch?
rationale: This PR changes parent-visible lifecycle and delivery semantics for stale subagent runs, and the branch currently conflicts with current main; automation cannot safely choose the product boundary or conflict resolution strategy.

options.title: Rebase and accept the boundary
options.body: Resolve conflicts while preserving current-main registry/reconciliation changes, then review and land the private transcript terminal-turn recovery if exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Require live Gateway race proof
options.body: Ask for redacted live Agent Teams or Gateway proof that reproduces context loss mid-run before accepting the lifecycle change.

options.title: Keep error-only fallback
options.body: Close or pause this candidate if maintainers decide stale lost-context recovery must not infer success from private transcript state.

recommendation.title: Rebase and accept the boundary
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts while preserving current-main registry/reconciliation changes, then review and land the private transcript terminal-turn recovery if exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the related boundary decision and have recent history in this agent lifecycle area.
